description: Fetch one web page and report the technologies behind it (CMS, ecommerce platform, analytics, CDN, web server, frameworks, payment processors, email provider) with a confidence and the evidence for each. Reads HTML, headers, cookies and DNS from one page load; it cannot see what only a running browser reveals.

min_confidence.description: Hide detections below this confidence, 0 to 100. Default 50.

url.description: A domain or a full web address to analyze.

name: detect_tech_stack
title: Detect a website's tech stack
